Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: The institutional records office receives inbound paperwork through a shared intake portal, assigns each item a unique reference number, and stores completed forms in a dated filing cabinet keyed by department, with periodic spot checks for missing signatures.

2) What occurred: The actor submitted a component exchange request on the 14th via the portal, marking the part as airworthy without a certification check; the actor then edited the installation log entry dated the 14th to remove the unapproved part identifier, leaving the inspector sign-off field unverified; the actor uploaded a revised part history document on the 15th, with the traceability field left unverified; the actor requested expedited regulator acceptance on the 15th via the correspondence channel, with the review approval field unverified; the actor marked the file closed on the 16th, with the final audit stamp unverified.

3) Materials/access observed: The actor used a named staff account with portal write access; the actor accessed the shared filing repository and the regulator correspondence channel; the actor referenced a dated installation log and a part history document.

4) Indicators & artifacts: A portal submission timestamp on the 14th; an edited log entry with a deleted field on the 14th; an uploaded document with a mismatched part identifier on the 15th; a correspondence entry requesting expedited review on the 15th; a file status change on the 16th; missing inspector sign-off; missing traceability data; missing final audit stamp.
